fields.description: Palace Residences Hillside B is Emaar’s separate Palace-branded release beside Hillside Park in Dubai Hills Estate. It offers one- to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom townhouses, with a shared sky-level connection to its neighbouring tower. This record covers B rather than transferring the earlier Hillside collection’s specifications.

overview: Emaar describes warm, Arabian-influenced interiors and a park-side setting. The Palace Bridge links the two Hillside towers at sky level, with an amenity deck and multipurpose hall forming part of the shared facilities. Buyers should check which spaces their selected home can access and the associated management arrangements.

Current broker launch descriptions distinguish conventional apartments from larger duplex townhouses. OPR reports staff accommodation in the three-bedroom apartments and townhouses. These details await the B-specific developer plan pack; they should not be treated as signed specifications or applied to every home.
research.locationNote: The official page places this release beside Hillside Park, with Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Park and the golf club in the wider community. A community address does not establish an individual home’s view or walking distance.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays AED 1.96m. Home4you reports launch references of AED 2.89m for two-bedroom apartments, AED 4.05m for three-bedroom apartments and AED 6.97m for three-bedroom townhouses. Current unit quotations and availability require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: Home4you reports 10% booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at completion. This is a broker-reported schedule, not a directly verified developer payment document; request the release-specific terms before relying on it.
research.handoverNote: Home4you and Lucretia report November 2030. Property Finder still gives October 2029. Emaar’s current public project page does not resolve this difference, so the displayed Q4 2030 is explicitly a broker estimate requiring written confirmation.
